activationModal.title: Deploy to n8n
activationModal.urlInvalid: Please enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL
activationModal.urlHelp: Base URL only, including https:// — e.g. https://n8n.example.com. Do not add a path like /workflow/abc or /home (pasting the editor address is fine — it is trimmed automatically).
activationModal.apiKeyHelp: In your n8n: Settings → n8n API → Create an API key.
activationModal.apiKeyRoleWarning: The key must be created from an Owner / admin account on that n8n instance. Keys made by member accounts lack permission to create or activate workflows, and deployment will fail.
activationModal.storageLocalDesc: Stored in this browser's localStorage. Fast, but lost if you clear browser data, and this workflow's canvas, execution logs and fixtures won't be able to reload after you leave this page.
activationModal.storageDatabaseDesc: Stored server-side (encrypted) and available across devices. Requires account. Recommended — needed for this workflow's canvas, execution logs and fixtures to reload later.
activationModal.errorMissingCreds: n8n instance URL and API key are required.
activationModal.errorInvalidCreds: n8n rejected this API key. Verify the key is correct AND was created by an Owner/admin account — member keys cannot deploy workflows.
activationModal.errorUnreachable: Could not reach your n8n instance. Verify the URL.
activationModal.errorNetwork: Could not reach server. Check your connection.
activationModal.errorCredentialDbSave: Credentials saved locally, but the database save failed. They will still work for this session.

customizeAgent.descDeploy: Once this agent is set up the way you want, put it to work on a channel.
